origin.source: Ported in spirit from v1 todo.ts (next branch)

comparison.purpose: One `agent.plan` invoke maps a free-text command onto a sequence of a real app's machine events (ADD/TOGGLE/DELETE/NOTHING/QUIT): a multi-action command drives several plan steps in order, NOTHING (the stopOn sentinel) ends the plan, and guard-enforced honesty rejects nonexistent ids mid-plan with a retry. Ships a with/without-machine A/B pair (index.ts vs imperative.ts) so agent.plan's typed events, mid-plan guard rejection+retry, and resumable snapshot can be compared against a hand-rolled generateObject while-loop.
